name: github-agent-skills
description: Thirteen evidence-based GitHub workflows for inspection and local preparation with human authorisation for remote actions.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect GitHub evidence and prepare local changes
interface.longDescription: Thirteen workflows for repository audits, README editing, profile curation, release preparation, issue drafting, issue triage, breaking a specification into issues, issue implementation, branch review, pull request descriptions, addressing pull request review feedback, diagnosing failing CI checks and reviewing open pull requests. Remote actions need explicit human authorisation.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this repository and prepare an evidence-based local release handoff.
